scope: Seven integration interfaces in Chapters 10 and 12–17. This is not an independent whole-book audit or verification of a physical/host implementation.
source_revision: synchronized reconstructed edition v1.0.0; exact source SHA-256 supplied

claims.normalized_claim: A surjective finite quotient preserving enabled sets, labels and joint successor/report rows preserves finite controlled path laws under a common admissible report-history policy.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty state/action/report sets; normalized nonnegative enabled rows.
Same projected prior and the same policy observation interface.
Policy actions admitted throughout each positive-mass support.
dependency_graph: Representative-independent row construction preserves normalization.
Nonnegative finite sums preserve projected supports and action intersections.
Induction over complete projected state paths factors out the common policy weight.

obligations.item: Representative-independent row construction preserves normalization.
Nonnegative finite sums preserve projected supports and action intersections.
Induction over complete projected state paths factors out the common policy weight.

edge_cases_checked: Zero-mass histories; disabled padded columns; empty common enabled set.
Separate successor/report marginals fail; their joint law is necessary.
claims.remaining_gap: None within the stated finite mathematical hypotheses.
claims.strongest_safe_statement: A surjective finite quotient preserving enabled sets, labels and joint successor/report rows preserves finite controlled path laws under a common admissible report-history policy.
claims.cheapest_next_check: Validate the observation, action, interpretation and cost interfaces separately for any concrete host implementation.

claims.locator: Chapter 12, Core:r:control-predecessor, Core:r:control-transport, Core:r:stochastic-support-game and Core:r:control-envelope
claims.normalized_claim: Exact legal successor quotients transport ending attractors, safe-running kernels and ranks; conservative successor enclosures give one-sided winning certificates.
hypotheses: Same enabled mode catalogues and exact projected successors for the equality result.
Safety and goal sets are inverse images. Successor sets are nonempty.
Lifted policies require access to the current coarse state and command mode.
dependency_graph: Successor inclusion in an inverse image is equivalent to projected inclusion.
Inverse images commute with the union/intersection fixed-point recurrences.
First-entry stages agree; rank decreases under the lifted ending policy.
For enclosures, fewer admitted actions and more adverse successors preserve soundness in the stated direction.

hypotheses: Finite nonempty history set and attained record domains.
M F_a=P_a M and N F_a=Q_a N for the same total source action.
Translator J satisfies JM=N on histories.
dependency_graph: Define the translator on each attained old record using fibre constancy.
At u=M(h), JP_a u=N(F_a h)=Q_a Ju.
Closure retains the attained domain for word induction.

claims.normalized_claim: Derivation-valued rule witnesses transport causal derivations; a backward witness map with gf=id reflects old consequences and the specified pullback prohibition.
hypotheses: Finite source and target fields with fixed seeds and admitted rules.
Each translated source rule is target-derivable from translated premises.

dependency_graph: Causal replay is monotone under stronger initial knowledge.

Concatenation translates seed traces and each actual source rule witness.

claims.normalized_claim: Partial primitive, Boolean-test and cost factorization extend by structural induction to all finite programs in the declared grammar, preserving failure, events, projected paths and charges.
hypotheses: Finite syntax without loops or recursion.
Failure is represented by a distinct bottom value and is reflected by the quotient.
Actual tests and each coordinate charge factor through the same state map.
dependency_graph: Primitive and skip cases match directly.

Equal tests select the same branch; charges and records concatenate.

claims.locator: Chapter 17, Core:integration:interpreted-replay and the guarded/repeated-dispatch/resource theorems
claims.normalized_claim: Sound fibre-wide seeds and rules yield a guard for the same actual modeled program; guarded dispatch preserves its declared path contract, and repeated dispatch preserves the stated epoch invariant and finite-prefix resource account.
hypotheses: Seeds hold throughout the actual observation fibre; rules preserve interpreted truth.
Guard interpretation is contained in the actual program’s success/safety/target/budget set.
State, program and semantic binding remain the same at dispatch, or a declared change relation is covered.
Every performed workflow operation is included in the nonnegative coordinate account.
dependency_graph: Closure-stage truth induction gives interpreted replay.
Guard-set membership yields the one-dispatch contract by definition.
Relational-image monotonicity gives the stated robust-change variant.
Endpoint-invariant induction gives repeated safety; telescoping gives the resource identity.

obligations.item: Closure-stage truth induction gives interpreted replay.
Guard-set membership yields the one-dispatch contract by definition.
Relational-image monotonicity gives the stated robust-change variant.
Endpoint-invariant induction gives repeated safety; telescoping gives the resource identity.

edge_cases_checked: Stale observations; a changed program binding; rejected proposals.
Zero-cost steps do not imply termination. Macro-action safety does not prove instruction-level interruptibility.
claims.remaining_gap: None within the stated finite mathematical hypotheses.
claims.strongest_safe_statement: Sound fibre-wide seeds and rules yield a guard for the same actual modeled program; guarded dispatch preserves its declared path contract, and repeated dispatch preserves the stated epoch invariant and finite-prefix resource account.
claims.cheapest_next_check: Validate the observation, action, interpretation and cost interfaces separately for any concrete host implementation.

overall: All seven focused interface claims proved as written under their explicit hypotheses.
